title: From complexity to clarity: How visibility enables smarter decisions in the healthcare supply chain

body_markdown:
*Throughout National Healthcare Supply Chain Week (October 4-10), we’re proud to celebrate our supply chain colleagues and their significant contributions to patient care. We’re grateful for the impactful ways they support healthcare organizations and their communities.*


*By Emily Gallo, senior vice president and general manager of OptiFreight® Logistics at Cardinal Health*


This Healthcare Supply Chain Week, I’m reflecting on how our industry has transformed to keep pace with modern medicine, and the dedicated teams whose expertise and dedication have made that evolution possible.


Advances in medications, cell and gene therapies, biologics and other innovative treatments are improving patient outcomes every day. As healthcare evolves, so do the demands placed on the supply chain that supports it.


Today's healthcare supply chain requires far more than simply shipping a product from a manufacturer to a provider, from a provider to a patient, and anywhere in between. It demands real-time insight, actionable data and the ability to turn that information into smart, timely clinical decisions.


In an environment where a delayed shipment can impact patient outcomes, visibility, speed, accuracy and precision are no longer nice-to-haves. In supporting healthcare provider customers, the OptiFreight® Logistics team sees visibility becoming central to the work we do every day.


**Why visibility matters**


Healthcare providers need more than shipment status updates. They need the ability to identify potential issues early, understand operational impact, and make decisions quickly enough to counteract disruptions in patient care.


New time-sensitive precision medicine treatments, temperature-sensitive biologics and pharmaceuticals are changing lives, but only when they reach patients in the right place, at the right time and in optimal condition.


Achieving this requires us to partner strategically with our provider customers as they rethink how the healthcare supply chain operates. Because new treatments require careful handling and precise delivery timing to maintain product integrity, real-time visibility across the shipment network is critical, so quick interventions can be deployed at a moment’s notice.


Technology alone is no longer an operational differentiator. Today's landscape requires a combination of tools, clean data and human expertise to set the foundation for decisive action.


Access to timely, accurate information empowers teams to proactively manage risks and intervene at the first sign of delay or disruption, allowing them to build a supply chain that is resilient enough to safeguard uninterrupted patient care.


**Seeing your supply chain clearly**


Supply chains generate enormous amounts of data every day. Every shipment, scan, delivery event and transportation decision creates intelligence that can help organizations better understand their operations. But visibility requires more than data collection; fragmented, outdated or disorganized data slows decision-making rather than accelerating it.


To see your supply chain clearly, visibility platforms must deliver organized, clean and current data, so that you can transform information into meaningful action. OptiFreight® Logistics helps customers transform complex logistics data into actionable intelligence. Rather than presenting shipment data as a collection of isolated events, our visibility dashboard synthesizes events into broader operational patterns, identifying trends and opportunities for improvement.


In the modern healthcare supply chain, this is critical to allow organizations to have the right information not only to determine what logistics actions they should take, but when to take them.


**Turning visibility into action**


One of the biggest misconceptions about supply chain visibility is that it is simply about knowing where a package is. True visibility provides a comprehensive view of the broader logistics ecosystem to enable action. Visibility enables leaders to see the bigger picture, empowering them to identify risks early and make quick and smart decisions about when how to intervene and get ahead of delays before they impact patient care.


Imagine you’re a pharmacist. If someone asked you what your average day looks like, you'd probably describe a long list of priorities: medication safety, staffing constraints, growing patient expectations, inventory management ... the list goes on. And on that list, another crucial responsibility is making sure that therapies get where they need to go, and when.


When everything goes according to plan, logistics operates quietly in the background. But when a critical shipment is delayed, it can quickly move to the top of a pharmacist’s priority list.


That’s where OptiFreight® Logistics team comes in. By combining shipment visibility data with healthcare logistics expertise, the team makes sure to identify potential disruptions in real-time, working behind the scenes with carriers to resolve issues quickly and alert customers. Using visibility dashboards to pinpoint a shipment's location and insight into a customer’s requirements, the team can coordinate with carriers to intervene and place priority delivery on items that need it.


We never lose track of knowing that our work is about so much more than moving a package from point A to point B. It is about bringing lifesaving innovation to patients and their families and allowing healthcare providers to focus on patient care. Laboratory staff and providers do not have the time to call to track down a package. Their job is to advance patient care — not wait on hold.


Whether delivering a patient prescription, replenishing critical inventory or sending a patient specimen to a lab, reliable logistics play a vital role in healthcare delivery. When healthcare organizations have confidence in their supply chain, they can spend less time managing logistical uncertainties and focus more time on what matters most: patient care.


During Healthcare Supply Chain Week, we recognize the people behind this progress. Through innovative technology, actionable analytics and a commitment to operational excellence, they are helping healthcare organizations navigate complexity, respond to disruptions and make sure critical products reach patients without delay.


Because in healthcare, visibility is more than knowing where a package is. It's about creating the clarity, confidence and connection needed to support better outcomes every step of the way.


*As the senior vice president and general manager of*[OptiFreight® Logistics at Cardinal Health](https://www.cardinalhealth.com/en/solutions/optifreight-logistics.html) *, Emily Gallo is focused on leading a team that is building tech products to innovate the way healthcare supply chain leaders manage logistics and remove costs. During her tenure at Cardinal Health, Gallo also has led executive customer engagement strategy and several medical product businesses.*
